body: Concavity bounds improvement by the tangent. A linear function on the simplex maximizes at zero or delta times a coordinate vector. Its negative coefficients require lower endpoints and positive coefficients upper endpoints. A poor or stalled proposal optimizer can weaken a sound certificate, not invalidate this inequality.
